fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
Detects the presence of the "u202+E" character, which causes a terminal, browser, or operating system to render text in a right-to-left sequence.
This is used as an obfuscation and masquerading techniques.
fields.name: Potential Defense Evasion Via Right-to-Left Override
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\u202e" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "[U+202E]"))
